metadata.title: LSP final-surface builder/mutation/registration inventory
metadata.train_stage: S01 differential inventory (no production behavior change)
metadata.scope_note: Migration evidence for the #8032 train, not a second capability catalog. Rows are bijective with the serialized static-builder census plus the runtime mutation/registration surface proven by perl-lsp-rs final-surface census tests. The checked-in JSON is the host-target artifact; wasm32 renders target-scoped rows and uses a dedicated guard instead of equality with this file.

compatibility.subject: JetBrains-family clients (name contains jetbrains/intellij/idea, case-insensitive)
compatibility.reason: their dynamic watcher registration flow is unreliable and degrades startup; forces caps.dynamic_registration_support=false regardless of declaration and queues one-time logMessage after initialized
compatibility.expiry: until EffectiveLspSurface introduces typed compatibility policy (#9665)

compatibility.subject: OpenCode clients advertising pull diagnostics
compatibility.reason: OpenCode relies on push publishDiagnostics even while declaring textDocument.diagnostic; pull gating suppressed to avoid losing diagnostics
compatibility.expiry: revisit under #6735 negotiation matrix when OpenCode consumes pull diagnostics

rows.protocol_field: process current directory used when no root signal exists (e.g. Aider)
rows.evidence_owner: cwd fallback in handle_initialize; lifecycle test initialize_uses_current_directory_when_root_is_missing

compatibility.subject: lightweight clients initializing without any root signal
compatibility.reason: prevents an uninitialized workspace state for minimal clients

rows.evidence_owner: initializationOptions fallback chain in handle_initialize; lifecycle tests initialize_init_options_workspace_folders_sets_root_path / initialize_reads_root_uri_from_initialization_options

compatibility.subject: clients placing workspace roots inside initializationOptions instead of top-level params
compatibility.reason: mirrors top-level resolution order after all standard fields are absent

rows.evidence_owner: legacy fallback chain in handle_initialize; lifecycle tests initialize_uses_current_directory_when_root_is_missing

compatibility.subject: older JetBrains LSP clients sending rootPath
compatibility.reason: rootPath converted to file URI and used after workspaceFolders/rootUri checks fail
compatibility.expiry: drop when minimum supported client floor excludes legacy JetBrains versions

rows.protocol_field: parsed-but-unadvertised client negotiation inputs: workspace.workspaceEdit.{documentChanges|snippetEditSupport|metadataSupport}; completion.completionList.{itemDefaults(data)|applyKindSupport}; textDocument.codeAction.{disabledSupport|tagSupport.valueSet(1=LLMGenerated)|dataSupport}; declaration/definition/typeDefinition/implementation.linkSupport; window.showDocument.support; window.workDoneProgress; diagnostic.markupMessageSupport; textDocument.diagnostic.relatedDocuments (not parsed on current main)
rows.evidence_owner: #6735 negotiation matrix; lifecycle tests initialize_parses_* / initialize_leaves_*_disabled_when_absent

compatibility.subject: client-negotiated behavior variants with no dedicated serverCapabilities advertisement field
compatibility.reason: each input is parsed in handle_initialize into ClientCapabilities and consumed downstream by providers/edits/outbound requests (#8068/#8285); recorded once so the denominator stays closed instead of implying an advertisement seam that does not exist
compatibility.expiry: S02 EffectiveLspSurface models each as a typed negotiation outcome (#9665)

rows.protocol_field: snippetSupport/commitCharactersSupport flattened onto textDocument.completion accepted beside completionItem.* shape
rows.evidence_owner: dual-shape parse branch in handle_initialize; lifecycle tests initialize_parses_completion_item_capabilities_from_flattened_shape

compatibility.subject: generic clients flattening completionItem booleans onto textDocument.completion
compatibility.reason: both shapes parsed; flattened form wins only when completionItem lacks the key

compatibility.subject: clients built on lsp-types/helix-lsp-types emit singular diagnostic on the wire
compatibility.reason: spec key is plural diagnostics; dropping singular would regress lsp-types-based clients (Helix)
compatibility.expiry: when observed clients stop emitting the singular spelling; dual-read guarded by tests until then

rows.protocol_field: general.markup.contentFormat -> textDocument.hover.contentFormat legacy fallback -> default markdown=true

compatibility.subject: clients omitting general.markup.contentFormat
compatibility.reason: legacy fallback reads hover.contentFormat; absent both, markdown assumed supported
compatibility.expiry: until #9665 canonical negotiation model owns markup selection

rows.protocol_field: positionEncoding always advertised utf-16 despite general.positionEncodings negotiation
rows.evidence_owner: phase-comment block in handle_initialize; position authority #2298

compatibility.subject: every client negotiating a non-UTF-16 preferred encoding
compatibility.reason: providers still compute UTF-16 offsets; advertising anything else would corrupt positions, so the negotiated value is stored but not advertised
compatibility.expiry: #8032 train stage threading the negotiated encoding through position/text contracts
